optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Business Intelligence Engineer, Treasury Management Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced Business Intelligence Engineer with three years of ownership over a treasury liquidity reporting suite, responsible for end‑to‑end release decisions, data‑model development, and change‑board leadership.
experienceHighlights: Owned the liquidity reporting suite for four treasury desks, acting as product owner and deciding release schedules.
Built and maintained SQL Server/SSAS data models and Power BI report layer for intraday cash positions and liquidity ratios.
Led the monthly reporting change board with desk heads, recording decisions in minutes.
Coordinated data‑source changes with the platform team, documenting responsibility boundaries.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Treasury technology register entry naming candidate as product owner; release log and change‑board minute provided as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s ownership of the liquidity reporting suite, release decision authority, data‑model and report development, change‑board leadership, and coordination with the platform team. They do not provide evidence of documentation of limitations or hand‑over conditions for each release.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets all listed requirements based on available evidence; further verification of documentation practices is recommended.

role.roleTitle: Business Intelligence Engineer, Treasury Management Platform

evidence.text: Owned the liquidity reporting suite for the treasury desks for three years: I decided and executed the release of each report version to the desks, as the named product owner for the suite in the treasury technology register.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of ownership and release decisions.

evidence.text: Work sample: the treasury technology register entry naming the candidate as product owner, the release log for the suite and one change-board minute, with the reporting platform's release identifiers as a verification trail.
Built and maintained the reporting data models (SQL Server, SSAS) and the report layer (Power BI) for intraday cash positions and liquidity ratios.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of data‑model and report layer work.

evidence.text: Led the monthly reporting change board with the desk heads, deciding which change requests were scheduled and recording the decisions in the change-board minutes.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of change board leadership.

evidence.text: Coordinated data-source changes with the platform team through the platform change process, recording that the platform team owned the source feeds while I owned the reporting models and releases.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of coordination and responsibility boundaries.

missingEvidence: Evidence that the candidate documents known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each report release.
